## GP - Score & Prioritize
Turns all page findings into one ranked backlog.

**In:** all audited pages at once (rule findings + Claude issues)
**Out:** one row per backlog item, ranked: rank, finding, scope, owner, impact, effort, priority, quadrant, detail, evidence, needs_review

Called once per run by GP - Audit Orchestrator.

### How the ranking works
**Impact** = how bad the finding is (1–3) × how important the page type is (page 3, guides 2, success stories 2, blog 1)
**Effort** = how hard to fix (1–3)
**Priority** = impact ÷ effort

**Quadrant:**
- Quick Win = high impact, low effort
- Big Bet = high impact, more effort
- Fill-in = low impact, low effort
- Deprioritize = low impact, more effort

**Grouping** (when a finding is on 3+ pages and at least half of all pages):
- Rule finding → one **template** row (one fix in the site template fixes all pages)
- Claude finding → one **pattern** row (content guideline) + one row per page (each page needs its own fix)

The weights are a first draft. To be agreed with marketing.
